sql.query: SELECT o.id,o.milestoneId,o.optionName,o.displayOrder,o.colour,o.isDefault,o.isComplete,o.isActive FROM tbl_event_milestone_options o INNER JOIN tbl_event_milestones m ON m.id=o.milestoneId AND m.tenantId=o.tenantId WHERE o.tenantId=:tenantId AND (:milestoneId=0 OR o.milestoneId=:milestoneId2) ORDER BY m.displayOrder,o.displayOrder,o.optionName
